title: The Hollow Protocol Again
author: Hazel Winterbourne
blurb: Wendell Ashgrove, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
